name: Titan Kin
startIntroPart1: The 'Titan Kin' corporation developed its own military policy and industry by challenging states; the council members aim to expand from a corporation into a state, and they intend to achieve this through various technologies.
startIntroPart2: Look at those massive walking robots, who needs tanks when you have them?
attacked: The Council will not forget this.
defeated: So, what kind of policy should we have pursued...
introduction: A company moving towards the next step
declaringFriendship: The Council has chosen you; what do you say to taking the next step with us?
tradeRequest: It's the most logical thing for both of us.

name: Lovers of the Wall
startIntroPart1: How could they not love the walls that saved them from extinction? During the ceremony—which is a time of war—the people known as the Lovers of the Wall renew the walls and polish their weapons, ensuring they are in prime condition; after all, they would not want to ruin the ceremony.
startIntroPart2: The grandeur and majesty of those walls simply take my breath away! Huh? You were here too, my friend!? Come on, let's become a Steampunk legend!
attacked: It's sheer stupidity, unless you move the ships overland.
declaringWar: What a joyous ceremony at the blessed wall!
defeated: The ceremony is ruined; how am I going to explain this...
introduction: Nice to meet you! I look forward to seeing you at the ceremony.
declaringFriendship: Let's be partners at the ceremony, man!
tradeRequest: An agreement that will cheer us both up!
uniques: [75]% City Strength from defensive buildings <when at war>

name: Golden Sultanate
startIntroPart1: A culturally rich realm composed of diverse peoples united by the bond of faith. Relentless against oppressors yet compassionate toward the downtrodden; they kneel only in the presence of Allah.
startIntroPart2: I swear by Allah that our sole aim is to exalt our religion and protect the poor and defenceless of the Ummah; our only response to those who seek to lead us astray is bullets.
attacked: It's sheer stupidity, unless you move the ships overland.
defeated: Even if we cease to exist, our religion will not...
denounced: You are adding to your record of deeds.
introduction: Assalamu alaikum, may God’s mercy be upon you.
declaringFriendship: Join the Ummah and enter the right path, my friend.
tradeRequest: This is the best option for both of us

name: Atomist Order
startIntroPart1: Seeing that God did not reach them, this people became self-reliant; their misfortunes and deprivation only fueled their anger, and they vowed to advance far enough to reach the outer layer.
startIntroPart2: God never reached out to us; we reached out to Him. We created our own miracles ourselves. We are not as lucky as the other lowly ones, but we are more intelligent than they are.
declaringWar: Rise up, my brothers; let us take back what is ours!
defeated: As always... even though our efforts didn't taste victory, it was an honorable fight.
declaringFriendship: Come with us, and let's touch the outer layer together.
tradeRequest: This is the best option for both of us
uniqueName: The Chosen Ones Among the Deprived
